messages:
Priya (growth): Quick idea — run a creative-hook lift test for next launch post. comparing two primary hooks: 1) "free credits + quickstart templates" vs 2) "benchmark latency/cost story + invite webinar". short run (7 days) to inform funnel creative. thoughts?
Liam (analytics): +1. need clear primary metric. propose activation rate = first generation API call within 7 days, and secondary: credit redemption rate and webinar signups. also need sample size calc.
Ava (design): I can mock 2 hero variations today. will keep imagery consistent, only change headline + subcopy. want to A/B within same creative slot.
Marco (eng): Are we using existing inbound routing to surface credit offers? can wire cohort routing to different landing templates. I'll need the experiment cookie or query param to route flows.
Priya (growth): plan: send organic launch post to X and community channels, and run small paid social seeding. traffic splits via ?exp=hookA or ?exp=hookB. credit allocation: $50 starter credit for new signups, same for both arms.
Liam (analytics): sample calc quick note: baseline activation ~12% from recent launches. to detect 2.5pp lift with 80% power need ~12k visitors per arm. we can start smaller and run until either significance or 7 days. will backfill cohort attribution via event p.uid.
Ava (design): drafts ready in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. two headlines: "Build with free credits — get to working prototype" vs "See how Redwood beats latency/cost — join our benchmark webinar". emojis? i like subtle :rocket: on credits, and :chart_with_upwards_trend: on benchmarks.
Jonas (product): watch messaging mismatch. hookB (benchmarks) likely attracts infra/platform folks; might impact conversion quality. agree to track downstream retention and usage patterns.
Maya (ops): On the webinar side, if someone chooses hookB and clicks webinar CTA, we should pre-fill registration with their cohort tag. set utm=hookB_webinar.
Marco (eng): Routing / tracking plan: add query param exp=hookA|hookB, set cookie exp_cohort, populate signup event with exp_cohort. For webinar prefills use reg_cohort. I'll drop a small snippet: 
```
// set cohort cookie
if (qs.exp) document.cookie = `exp_cohort=${qs.exp};path=/;max-age=604800`;
// include on signup payload
payload.cohort = getCookie('exp_cohort') || 'unknown';
```
Priya (growth): timeline: drafts by EOD today, experiment live Thurs 9am PT, run for 7 days. primary dashboard: activation rate by cohort, credit_redeem %, webinar reg %, and avg tokens generated in 7 days.
Liam (analytics): I'll create a Lookerboard and add a quick rolling p-value monitor. ping me once Marco has event field.
Ava (design): will upload final art + 2 GIFs (short) + alt text. size optimized for socials.
Marco (eng): will deliver tracking PR by tomorrow morning and add route mapping for /landing?exp=.. to templates. can also add server-side fallback for bots.
Jonas (product): small ask: add a prompt-template CTA in hookA landing that surfaces 3 curated starter prompts (chat, summarization, codegen). helps measure immediate product utility.
Priya (growth): agreed. that also gives us a measurable CTA (template click -> template_use event).
Liam (analytics): final metric list: 
- primary: activation_7d (first_gen within 7d)
- secondary: credit_redemption_rate, webinar_reg_rate, template_click_rate, tokens_7d_median
- quality check: avg_response_length, manual sample pass rate (n=30 per cohort)

I'll set alerts: if activation drops >30% vs baseline or if redemption >2x expected (budget risk)
Maya (ops): note: set credit daily cap (e.g., $2k/day) so we don't overspend if one arm spikes.
Priya (growth): promo copy drafts: 
- HookA headline: "Get $50 to build with Redwood — starter templates inside"
- HookB headline: "How we cut inference cost 2x — join the benchmark webinar"
Keep CTAs short: "Claim credits" vs "Register — limited seats"
Ava (design): added button states and microcopy variations in Figma.
Marco (eng): PR merged, cookie and signup payload included. routing tests pass in staging.
DeployBot: deploy queued: marketing-landing-AB  (staging) — started by Marco — build 0.3.12 
Priya (growth): launching Thursday 9:00am PT. everyone, stand by for post-launch sync at 11am PT to check early reads.
Liam (analytics): will have initial dashboard ready by 9:30.
Jonas (product): I'll watch qualitative channels for confusion / wrong expectations.
Priya (growth): thanks team — hoping this gives quick clarity on whether credits-first or benchmark-first drives better activation and retention. we’ll reconvene Mon for 7-day readout. :rocket:
